title: dsh-ops bench run.json
description: One sealed measurement, and the only place bench data lives (bench/README.md, hard boundary 1). The panel and the comparison read this document; nothing is inlined into panel.html. Event bodies are written as NDJSON while a sweep runs (crash safe) and merged into this document when it is sealed. Every numeric field names its unit in its description.

schemaVersion.description: Contract revision of THIS document; a reader must reject a version it does not know. Bumped only when a field changes meaning.

meta.description: Provenance of the sweep: what ran, where, on which runtime, and the exact command line. Every clock in this document that is not derived from the rows lives here or in `events.mergedAt`.

benchVersion.description: Version of the bench harness (package.json of the dsh-ops checkout).

mode.description: Measurement mode: "ab" is the model-driven token A/B, "tools" is the model-free deterministic tool-level comparison.

platform.description: Host tag as <platform>-<arch>, e.g. linux-x64 or win32-x64.

node.description: Node.js version the runner ran on, e.g. v24.21.0.

dsh.description: Version of the dsh launcher both arms were measured with, or null when unknown.

model.description: Model id both arms used, or null for the model-free mode.

condition.description: Explicit shared routing condition; absent/null means unknown for historical or unconfigured runs. Null reasoning effort means the host default was not pinned.

provider.description: Configured provider identifier shared by both arms.

model.description: Configured model identifier shared by both arms.

reasoningEffort.description: Pinned reasoning level, or null when the host default was not explicitly pinned.

gitSha.description: Commit the checkout was on, or null when it could not be read.

gitBranch.description: Branch the checkout was on, or null when it could not be read.

argv.description: The command line that produced this document, one array element per argv entry.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock start of the sweep, ISO 8601 UTC; derived from the rows when the caller did not pass one.

endedAt.description: Wall-clock end of the sweep, ISO 8601 UTC, derived from the rows when the caller did not pass one, or null while it is still running.

arms.description: Compact identity of the two arms compared: label and profile fingerprint. The full descriptor is the top-level `arms`.

base.description: The baseline side's label, profile name, and profile fingerprint.

label.description: Baseline arm label, also its profile name, e.g. bench-base.

profile.description: Baseline profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the baseline's dumped configuration.

cand.description: The candidate side's label, profile name, and profile fingerprint.

label.description: Candidate arm label, also its profile name, e.g. bench-ops.

profile.description: Candidate profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the candidate's dumped configuration.

arms.description: The two sides of the comparison, described fully enough to reproduce them.

results.description: One record per task x repeat x arm: the measurement rows the comparison and the panel pair up.

verify.description: Run-level rollup of the per-row check results, for the panel's scoring tab.

checks.description: Number of individual checks recorded across every row, as a count.

passed.description: How many of those checks passed, as a count.

failed.description: How many of those checks failed, as a count.

degraded.description: True when at least one row cannot support a cost conclusion (timed out, crashed, interrupted, or usage was not fully reported).

notes.description: Human-readable caveats, one sentence per array item.

events.description: How the event stream is archived: written as NDJSON during the sweep, merged into this document when it is sealed. `results[].events.inline` carries the merged bodies.

layout.description: On-disk layout of the event stream: "ndjson-per-run" while a sweep is in flight, "merged" once the bodies have been folded into this document.

merged.description: True when this document carries the event bodies in results[].events.inline; false when only the NDJSON files hold them.

mergedAt.description: When the NDJSON files were merged, ISO 8601 UTC, or null while unsealed.

files.description: The NDJSON files this document was sealed from, each hashed so a reader can prove the merge.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory, with forward slashes.

events.description: Number of event lines in this file, as a count.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file in hex, or null when it was not hashed.

archive.description: The manifest of one sealed run directory: every file that is part of the evidence, with its size and hash. The sealed run.json itself is not listed — it cannot hash itself.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory, with forward slashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file in hex.

role.description: What the file is: the contract document itself, the event stream, captured stderr, the narrated trace, a row's metrics document, a rendered report, the panel, a runner log, or anything else.

arm.description: One arm of the comparison: what it was called, which profile contents it ran, and how it was launched.

components.description: Component states read from composed configuration, not a publication/readiness receipt. Null for older or injected records.

label.description: Arm label, also the profile name it ran, e.g. bench-base.

profile.description: Profile name whose resolved configuration was measured.

profileHash.description: SHA-256 in hex of the arm's dumped configuration, the single-variable fingerprint.

dshPath.description: Absolute path of the lib/bin.js the arm ran, or null when unknown.

dshVersion.description: dsh version the arm ran, or null when unknown.

env.description: The environment overrides this arm was given, as name -> value (null means the name was removed).

result.description: One measured task x repeat x arm row.

taskId.description: Id of the task this row measured.

repeatIndex.description: 1-based repeat number of this task within the sweep.

arm.description: Which arm this row belongs to, by arm label.

profile.description: Profile name this row ran under, or null when the row did not record one.

verify.description: One entry per declared check, in declared order.

verifyPassed.description: True when every check on this row passed; the row-level copy of the verdict the run rollup counts.

verifyError.description: Why the verifier could not produce a verdict, or null when it ran.

traceFile.description: Path of this row's narrated trace relative to the run directory, or null when there is none; the file itself is registered in `archive[]` and never inlined.

stderrFile.description: Path of this row's captured stderr relative to the run directory, or null when there is none; the file itself is registered in `archive[]` and never inlined.

interrupted.description: True when the operator stopped this row before it finished.

spawnError.description: Why the child could not be spawned, or null when it started.

runnerError.description: Why the row's own runner failed (fixture or verifier), or null when it completed; a row is still returned so one broken row cannot erase a sweep.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline this row was given, in milliseconds (ms).

archiveErrors.description: Write failures the archiving streams reported for this row, one message per array item.

metrics.description: The measured numbers of one row: execution facts from the session driver plus the P6 aggregate of the same event stream. Token counts are absolute totals for the row, never deltas.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock start of this row, ISO 8601 UTC.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of this row in milliseconds (ms), measured around the child process.

exit.description: Child process exit code, or null when the row timed out or was killed before it could exit.

timedOut.description: True when the task deadline killed this row.

interrupted.description: True when the operator stopped this row before it finished.

spawnError.description: Why the child could not be spawned, or null when it started.

runnerError.description: Why the row's runner failed (fixture or verifier), or null when it completed.

steps.description: Model steps (requests) in this row, as a count.

stepsWithUsage.description: Steps in this row that reported usage, as a count; a step that reported none makes the token totals a lower bound.

turns.description: Model turns in this row, as a count.

toolCalls.description: Tool invocations in this row, as a count.

toolErrors.description: Tool results in this row whose status was error, as a count.

usageReported.description: True when every step reported usage. False makes the token totals a lower bound, so the row cannot support a cost conclusion.

usageBucketsSeen.description: Bucket names the provider actually reported in this row, sorted; `reasoningTokens` appears only when it was reported.

format.description: Format tag of the P6 metrics document this row was folded from, so a reader can tell which shape it is holding.

profile.description: Profile name the aggregate was given for this row, or null when it was not told.

sessionId.description: Session id the row's first `session` event carried, or null when none reached the stream.

stepUsage.description: Per-step attribution: one entry per step_end, in step order, each naming the tools called during that step.

toolUsage.description: Per-tool attribution, keyed by tool name; the entries' usage totals sum back to the steps that called them.

unattributedUsage.description: Usage of the steps that called no tool at all, split the way the runtime reported it.

toolCallsByName.description: Tool invocations broken down by tool name, each value a count.

turnEndReason.description: Why the model loop ended, as reported by the runtime, or null when unknown.

textChars.description: Characters of assistant text the stream carried, as a count; no bytes were decoded twice.

thinkingChars.description: Characters of reasoning text the stream carried, as a count.

finalTextBytes.description: Size of the final answer's text in bytes.

finalSeen.description: True when a `final` event reached the stream.

eventCount.description: Events folded into the aggregate, as a count.

malformedLines.description: Stdout lines that were not a JSON object, as a count.

truncatedLines.description: Events the stream marked truncated, as a count.

errorEvents.description: Errors the runtime reported on the stream, one entry per event.

traceRows.description: Rows in this row's narrated trace file, as a count; the trace itself is only registered in `archive[]`.

milestones.description: Trace rows in the milestone lanes (boot, milestone, stall), as a count.

archiveErrors.description: Write failures the archiving streams reported for this row, one message per array item.

usage.description: Token usage of one row, split the way the runtime reports it: the four core buckets are always present, `grandTotal` is their sum, and `reasoningTokens` appears only when the provider reported it.

inputTokens.description: Uncached prompt tokens, as a count of tokens.

outputTokens.description: Completion tokens, as a count of tokens.

cacheReadTokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prompt cache, as a count of tokens.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Prompt tokens written into the prompt cache, as a count of tokens.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning tokens the provider billed, as a count of tokens; absent — not zeroed — when the provider does not report them.

grandTotal.description: Input + output + cache read + cache write, as a count of tokens; reasoning tokens are deliberately not a term.

prompt.description: Prompt-size summary of one row, all prompt token counts: what was re-sent to the model rather than produced by it.

reported.description: True when every step reported a usable size, so the summary is complete.

firstStep.description: Prompt tokens of the run's first request, as a count of tokens, or null when that step reported no size.

median.description: Median prompt tokens per step, as a count of tokens, or null when no step reported a size.

max.description: Largest prompt of any step, as a count of tokens, or null when no step reported a size.

total.description: Sum of every step's prompt tokens, as a count of tokens, or null when no step reported a size.

perTurn.description: The first request of each turn, in turn order; separates asking little from carrying little.

perTurnPrompt.description: The first step of one turn and the prompt tokens it sent.

turn.description: Turn number the stream labelled, or null when it did not.

tokens.description: Prompt tokens of that turn's first request, as a count of tokens.

stepUsage.description: One step's usage and the tools it called; the usage is null when that step reported nothing usable, never a zero row.

turn.description: Turn number the stream labelled, or null when it did not.

step.description: Step number the stream labelled, or null when it did not.

promptTokens.description: Prompt tokens of this step, as a count of tokens, or null when the step reported no size.

usage.description: This step's bucket totals, or null when the step reported no usage.

tools.description: Names of the tools called during this step, in call order.

toolAttribution.description: What one tool was charged: its call count and the step usage split evenly across its calls.

calls.description: Calls to this tool, as a count.

steps.description: Steps that called this tool, as a count.

usageBucketsSeen.description: Bucket names that contributed to this tool's usage, sorted.

attribution.description: Conservation rollup of the attribution views: what the tools were charged, what no tool was charged for, and whether the two reconstitute the row.

tools.description: Tokens charged to tools, as a count of tokens.

unattributed.description: Tokens charged to no tool, as a count of tokens.

balanced.description: True when tools + unattributed equals the row's core token total, so the attribution view adds up.

errorEvent.description: One error the runtime reported on the event stream.

message.description: The error text, clamped for a human-readable report.

narration.description: Bounded P5 narration summary of one row: the milestone rows a reader should quote, capped, and whether the cap cut any.

excerpts.description: The first milestone-lane trace rows, in order, capped by the sealer; each is a copy of the narrated line, not the whole trace.

truncated.description: True when milestone rows were dropped by the cap; the full trace stays in the archive.

narrationRow.description: One narrated milestone, copied from the row's trace for the panel.

seq.description: 1-based position of this row in the trace, as a count.

at.description: Wall-clock time the line was narrated, ISO 8601 UTC.

offsetMs.description: Milliseconds (ms) since the row's trace started.

kind.description: Trace lane of the line, e.g. session, step_end, stall.

check.description: One declared verification check and its outcome on this row.

type.description: Check type as declared in the task file, e.g. fileEquals.

target.description: What was checked: the path, directory, or command, or null when the check has no target.

pass.description: True when the check held on this row.

detail.description: What was expected and what was found, in one line; a passing check keeps its evidence too (e.g. `present`, `matches expected content`) instead of being blanked.

evidence.description: Path of the evidence for this check, relative to the run directory, or null.

eventRef.description: Where this row's event body is: an NDJSON file during the sweep, inline in this document after the merge.

format.description: ndjson = the body is still only in a file; inline = the body is in `inline` in this document.

file.description: Path of the NDJSON file the body was read from, relative to the run directory, or null when there was none; kept after sealing so the archive can be checked.

count.description: Number of event lines for this row, as a count; equals the line count of the source file.

malformed.description: Lines in this row that were not a JSON object, as a count; they are not inlined because they are not events.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the NDJSON file in hex, or null when the file was absent.

inline.description: The event objects themselves, present only after sealing (format inline); each is one NDJSON line, verbatim.
